scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You know... this place doesn't seem to be safe for you. Please return to me once you have achieved ^0000FFLevel 99^000000 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
你知道嗎...這個地方對你來說似乎並不安全。請等你達到^0000FF99級^000000或以上時再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我不確定你是否已經徹底探索了時空裂縫。也許你應該再深入看看。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
What did you see in there?!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
你在裡面看到了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Hrumph, Sara Irene?! She's one of the 12 Valkyries. I didn't know her story was that tragic...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
哼，莎拉·艾琳？！她是十二瓦爾基里之一。我沒想到她的故事竟然如此悲慘...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
It seems that you caused a huge misunderstanding between her and her father.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
看來你造成了她和父親之間巨大的誤會。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You should not blame yourself for what occurred, or all the blood that was spilled. It seems that the events that day were fated to happen no matter who was there.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
你不應該為發生的一切，或者流下的鮮血而自責。看來那天的事件是命中註定的，無論誰在那裡都會發生。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Please don't tell anyone about your time travelling adventure. We can't have anyone thinking you more important than old Leon. Plus they wouldn't believe such a story anyway.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
請不要告訴任何人你時間旅行的冒險經歷。我們不能讓任何人覺得你比老雷恩更重要。而且他們也不會相信這種故事。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我想在你上次進入裂縫後大約20小時，它會穩定到足以讓你再次穿越。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我想在你上次進入裂縫後大約20小時，它會穩定到足以讓你再次穿越。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[ 莎拉的回憶 ] 緊急冷卻已解除。現在可以再次使用次元裝置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You wish to relive the past again?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
你想再次重溫過去嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Please venture through the dimensional device and report to me what you find within.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
請通過次元裝置探索，並向我彙報你在裡面發現的。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Though I should warn you. It might be unstable. Make sure you enter as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
不過我要提醒你。它可能不穩定。請確保儘快進入。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Well... I can't force you. But if you ever find the courage please talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
嗯...我不能強迫你。但如果你找到了勇氣，請再來找我談談。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我不確定你是否已經徹底探索了時空裂縫。也許你應該再深入看看。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[ 莎拉的回憶 ] 緊急冷卻已解除。現在可以再次使用次元裝置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I am not sure you have fully explored the crack in space and time yet. Perhaps you should look a bit further into it.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我不確定你是否已經徹底探索了時空裂縫。也許你應該再深入看看。

scripts.text: Okay
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text: Give up
scripts.translation: 放棄

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I am glad to hear that! Maybe someday you can be as brave as old Leon the Lion!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
聽到這個我很高興！也許有一天你能像老雷恩獅子一樣勇敢！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Well... I can't force you. But if you ever find the courage please talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
嗯...我不能強迫你。但如果你找到了勇氣，請再來找我談談。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
What did you see in there?!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
你在裡面看到了什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Hrumph, Sara Irene?! She's one of the 12 Valkyries. I didn't know her story was that tragic...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
哼，莎拉·艾琳？！她是十二瓦爾基里之一。我沒想到她的故事竟然如此悲慘...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
It seems that you caused a huge misunderstanding between her and her father.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
看來你造成了她和父親之間巨大的誤會。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You should not blame yourself for what occurred, or all the blood that was spilled. It seems that the events that day were fated to happen no matter who was there.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
你不應該為發生的一切，或者流下的鮮血而自責。看來那天的事件是命中註定的，無論誰在那裡都會發生。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Please don't tell anyone about your time travelling adventure. We can't have anyone thinking you more important than old Leon. Plus they wouldn't believe such a story anyway.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
請不要告訴任何人你時間旅行的冒險經歷。我們不能讓任何人覺得你比老雷恩更重要。而且他們也不會相信這種故事。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我想在你上次進入裂縫後大約20小時，它會穩定到足以讓你再次穿越。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Excuse my rudeness! I am Pon de Leon, the famous adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
抱歉我的無禮！我是龐·德·雷恩，著名的冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
My friends call me Leon the Lion! For my tough appearance and attitude. Plus I have quite the bite!
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我的朋友們叫我雷恩獅子！因為我的外表和態度都很強硬。而且我的狠咬也很厲害！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
You know, this is such a strange location...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
你知道嗎，這是一個非常奇怪的地方...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
As you explore it you start to see cracks in space and time. Each one covered by a dimensional device.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
當你探索它時，你會開始看到時空裂縫。每一個都被一個次元裝置覆蓋。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
For example, I think I have caught glimpses of Payon through the one closest to us. But it doesn't seem right. Almost like it is a little bit older than it should be.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
例如，我想我通過離我們最近的那個看到了斐揚。但看起來不對勁。幾乎像是它比應該的更古老一點。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I want to explore it, but with my old age and my knees I don't seem to be quite up to the task.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我想去探索那裡，但考慮到我的年紀和膝蓋的狀況，我似乎不太適合親自前往。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
So, I would like to ask something of you.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
所以，我想拜託你一件事。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Please venture through the dimensional device and report to me what you find within.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
請通過次元裝置探索，並向我彙報你在裡面發現的。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Though; I should warn you. It might be unstable. Make sure you enter as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
不過；我要提醒你。那裡可能很不穩定。請確保你能儘快進入。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Hey! You are too young to be playing with that! Come back when you are at least ^0000FFLevel 99^000000!
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
嘿！你還太小了，不能玩這個！等你至少達到^0000FF99級^000000再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Before you go playing around with that; Why don't you come over here and talk to me?
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
在你到處亂玩之前；何不先過來和我談談？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
Before you enter you need to organize a party! Don't you know how? Type /organize PARTYNAMEHERE.
scripts.translation:
[次元裝置]
在進入之前你需要組建一個隊伍！你不知道怎麼操作嗎？輸入 /organize PARTYNAMEHERE。

scripts.text: ^FF0000The dimensional device boots up cleanly. Use the device to enter the crack in space and time.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000次元裝置啟動正常。使用裝置進入時空裂縫。^000000

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
The memorial dungeon {0} does not exist.
The party leader did not generate the dungeon yet.
scripts.translation:
記憶地下城 {0} 不存在。
隊伍首領尚未生成地下城。

scripts.text: Only the registered members can enter the instance {0}.
scripts.translation: 只有註冊的成員才能進入副本 {0}。

scripts.text: ^FF0000The party leader did not boot up the dimensional device.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000隊伍首領尚未啟動次元裝置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Leon]
I think in about 20 hours after you last entered the rift, it will be stable enough for you to transverse it again.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 雷恩]
我想在你上次進入裂縫後大約20小時，它會穩定到足以讓你再次穿越。

scripts.text: ^0000FF[ Sara's Memories ] Cooldown has been cleared. It is now possible to use the dimensional device again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF[ 莎拉的回憶 ] 緊急冷卻已解除。現在可以再次使用次元裝置。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where am I?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[A Girl]
Hello! This is the village of Payon. You don't seem to be from around here...
scripts.translation:
[一個女孩]
你好！這裡是斐揚的村莊。你看起來不像是這裡的人...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you from here? You don't seem to quite match the locals either.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是這裡的人嗎？你看起來也不太像當地人。

scripts.text:
[A Girl]
Yes! I was born here! My name is Sara, Sara Irene!
scripts.translation:
[一個女孩]
是的！我出生在這裡！我叫莎拉，莎拉·艾琳！

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
My father is doyen of this village! I just take after my mother.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
我父親是這個村莊的元老！我只是隨了我母親。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! I am sorry! Uh... Why are you standing out here all alone?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！對不起！呃...你一個人站在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
I am waiting for my father. He said that he will be here soon.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
我在等我的父親。他說他很快就會回來。

scripts.text: ^FF0000An older man exits the house. Sara's face brightens at the sight of him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000一位年長的男子走出房子。莎拉看到他的臉頓時亮了起來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Hi Daddy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Sweetheart you look so happy.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
親愛的，你看起來很開心。

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
You said you would come back soon! I waited for you and you lied!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
你說過會很快回來的！我等了你好久，你竟然騙我！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Sweetheart, I am sorry I made you wait so long. The meeting with the village elders took longer than expected.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
親愛的，對不起讓你等了這麼久。和村里長老們的會議比預計的時間要長。

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
I hate those old fogeys.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
我討厭那些老頑固。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Don't say that sweetheart... Who is this with you?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
別這麼說，親愛的...這位是誰？

scripts.text: ^FF0000Doyen Irene stares at you with fire in his eyes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000元老 艾琳眼中閃爍著怒火，死死地盯著你。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Sara starts humming and singing softly to herself. She picks some wild flowers nearby and presents them to the Doyen.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉開始輕聲哼唱。她摘了一些附近的野花，遞給元老。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Here you go daddy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
給你，爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Oh Sara, may I have them?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
哦，莎拉，我可以收下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Of course silly daddy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
當然可以啦，笨蛋爸爸！

scripts.text: ^FF0000After being given the flowers the Doyen's mood seems to greatly improve.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000收到花後，元老的心情似乎好了很多。^000000

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Alright my princess, where should we go now?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
好了，我的公主，我們現在去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Oh daddy! Lets go to the top of that hill over there!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
哦，爸爸！我們去那邊的小山丘頂上吧！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Hah! Ok, hold onto me tight!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
哈哈！好，抓緊我！

scripts.text: ^FF0000As they wander off you hear strange voices from around the corner...^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000當他們走遠時，你聽到拐角處傳來奇怪的聲音...^000000

scripts.text:
[Strange Old Man]
I can feel Sara's power growing. We cannot just stand by and let her achieve her full potential!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
我能感覺到莎拉的力量在增長。我們不能坐視不管，讓她發揮全部潛力！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Old Man]
She was born under a bad sign and her mother isn't even one of us!
scripts.translation:
[神秘的老人]
她生在不吉的命格下，而且她母親甚至不是我們的人！

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Old Man]
Someday she will cause blood to flow in our streets.
scripts.translation:
[神秘的老人]
總有一天，她會讓我們街道血流成河。

scripts.text:
[Strange Old Man]
We have to do something before the Holy creatures select her. I asked 'HIM' to take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
在神聖生物選中她之前，我們必須做點什麼。我已經請“他”去處理了。

scripts.text:
[Mysterious Old Man]
We will see... I look forward to hearing the bad news that has befallen her...
scripts.translation:
[神秘的老人]
我們會看到的...我很期待聽到降臨在她身上的噩耗...

scripts.text: ^FF0000The old men wander off. It seems Sara might be in danger. We have to do something!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000老人們走遠了。莎拉似乎正處於危險之中。我們必須做點什麼！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Oh! Hello again! I remember you, what's up?
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
哦！又見面了！我記得你，有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
I am here to give flowers to my mommy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
我來給媽媽送花！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Sara leaps forward to open the door, flowers at the ready.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉跳上前去開門，手裡拿著花。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Mom! Dad! Look what I found!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
媽媽！爸爸！看我找到了什麼！

scripts.text: ^FF0000The door opens to reveal a woman near death laying on the floor and the Doyen standing over the woman with a bloody sword.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000門開了，裡面躺著一位奄奄一息的女子，元老正手持染血的劍站在她身旁。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...

scripts.text:
[Sara's Mother]
Sara...Ru-...away...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉的母親]
莎拉...快...跑...

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...

scripts.text: ^FF0000A gem rolls from the woman's hand and comes to a rest in front of Sara. Unconsciously Sara reaches down and picks up the gem.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000一顆寶石從女子手中滾落，停在莎拉麵前。莎拉下意識地伸手撿起了它。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000The Doyen turns around and notices Sara.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000元老轉過身，注意到了莎拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Ahh Sara! I was just looking for you...
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
啊，莎拉！我正好在找你...

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...

scripts.text: Escape with Sara.
scripts.translation: 帶著莎拉逃跑

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Guards! GUARDS!! There is a murderer here! Catch him!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
衛兵！衛兵！！這裡有殺人犯！抓住他！

scripts.text: ^FF0000The sound of many pairs of boots can be heard running outside!^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000外面傳來許多雙靴子奔跑的聲音！^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Mommy NO!!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
媽媽不！！！！！！！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Sara runs away and the sound of the guards is getting closer...^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000莎拉跑開了，衛兵的腳步聲越來越近...^000000

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
Mommy!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
媽媽！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Sara...
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
莎拉...

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
No!
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
不！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
I have been looking for you Sara. Please come with daddy, it is very dangerous here!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
我一直在找你，莎拉。請跟爸爸走，這裡很危險！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't let you take Sara!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不會讓你帶走莎拉的！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
The murderer is here! Guards! We will finish him once and for all!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
兇手在這裡！衛兵們！
我們要徹底解決他！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sara... run! Save yourself!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
莎拉...快跑！
救你自己！

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...okay.
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...好的。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
You... were too strong for me.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
你...太強了。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Why... *hack* are you trying to kill my wife and daughter?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
為什麼... *咳* 你要殺我的妻子和女兒？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you talking about? We saw you standing over Sara's mother with your sword COVERED in blood!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在說什麼？
我們看見你站在莎拉母親身邊，
你的劍上沾滿了血！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
You... think I killed Sara's mother?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
你...認為我殺了莎拉的親生母親？

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
She *cough* had already been stabbed by an assassin. I slew him *hack* that is why my blade was covered in blood...
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
她 *咳* 已經被刺客刺中了。
我殺死了他 *咳* 所以我的劍上才沾滿了血...

scripts.text: ^FF0000Thinking back, you seem to recall another body laying in the left corner of the room. Maybe that was the assassin the Doyen is talking about.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000回想起來，你似乎記得房間角落裡還有一具屍體。也許那就是元老所說的刺客。^000000

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
If... you are the not the assassin sent to kill my wife and daughter, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
如果...你不是那個被派來殺我妻女的刺客，那你到底是誰？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am just an adventurer who was passing through. I heard some strange men plotting their deaths and needed to intervene.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是個路過的冒險者。
我聽到幾個可疑的人在密謀殺害她們，所以不得不介入。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
If... you are telling the truth... forgive me. I thought you were one of them.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
如果...你說的是真的...請原諒我。我以為你是他們中的一員。

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
Strange men? ...I bet they were some of the village elders. Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
可疑的人？...我敢打賭他們是村裡的長老。唉...

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
There might be more assassins so we have to find Sara as fast as we can!
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
可能還有更多的刺客，我們必須儘快找到莎拉！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sara believes that you killed her mother. We need to tell her the truth!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
莎拉認為你殺了她的母親。我們需要告訴她真相！

scripts.text:
[Doyen Irene]
We must do our best to find her. Lets split up and search for her. Please help me find my daughter and explain everything to her.
scripts.translation:
[元老 艾琳]
我們必須盡力找到她。我們分頭去找吧。請幫我找到我的女兒，並向她解釋一切。

scripts.text: ^FF0000As you are about to call out to Sara, a sudden blow knocks you down from behind.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000當你正要呼喊莎拉時，背後突然遭到一擊，你倒在了地上。^000000

scripts.text:
[?????]
The time travellers cannot interfere any longer. You cannot stop us from meeting Sara.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
時間旅行者不能再幹涉了。你們無法阻止我們見到莎拉。

scripts.text:
[?????]
You should go back to the time where you belong.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
你們應該回到屬於你們的時間去。

scripts.text: ^FF0000As you fall to the ground, two dark figures approach Sara.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000當你倒在地上時，兩個黑影向莎拉逼近。^000000

scripts.text:
[?????]
A girl full of betrayal, despair, and hate. We will guide you to your ultimate fate.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
一個充滿背叛、絕望與仇恨的女孩。我們將引導你走向最終的命運。

scripts.text:
[Sara Irene]
...
scripts.translation:
[莎拉·艾琳]
...

scripts.text:
[?????]
Sara Irene, 'he' will make your dreams come true.
scripts.translation:
[?????]
莎拉·艾琳，“他”會讓你的夢想成真。

scripts.text: ^FF0000One of the cloaked strangers covers Sara with their cloak and all three figures disappear.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000其中一名蒙面陌生人用斗篷遮住莎拉，三人隨即消失。^000000
